tests.title: Singly Linked List - Sorted Insertion
tests.description: Insert a new integer into an existing singly linked list such that ascending sorted order is preserved.
tests.prompt: Complete the C function 'void insert_sorted(Node** head, int val)' that inserts 'val' into the singly linked list whose head pointer is '*head', maintaining ascending sorted order. Handle inserting into an empty list, at the head, in the middle, and at the end. Only return the function definition.

tests.title: Binary Max-Heap - Sift-Down Heapify
tests.description: Restore the max-heap property for a 0-indexed binary heap array at index i.
tests.signature: void max_heapify(int arr[], int n, int i)
tests.prompt: Complete the C function 'void max_heapify(int arr[], int n, int i)' that restores the max-heap property for the subtree rooted at index 'i' in a 0-indexed array 'arr' of size 'n'. Use standard 0-indexed heap formulas (left = 2*i + 1, right = 2*i + 2). Only return the function definition.

tests.title: Binary Search Tree - Node Deletion
tests.description: Delete a key from a Binary Search Tree and return the updated root pointer.
tests.prompt: Complete the C function 'Node* delete_node(Node* root, int key)' that deletes the node with value 'key' from the BST rooted at 'root'. Handle leaf nodes, 1-child nodes, and 2-child nodes (replace with inorder successor). Return the updated root pointer. Properly free() the deleted node. Only return the function definition.
